title.rendered: January is School Board Recognition Month!

content.rendered:
Oregon’s Governor Brown, and Sherwood’s Mayor Clark have issued proclamations deeming January 2017 as School Board Recognition Month!

If you have the opportunity, please take the time to say “Thank You!” to our wonderful Board members, who volunteer countless hours to our staff, students and community every year to ensure we keep Sherwood Schools – A Great Place For All Kids!
